name: Netboot.xyz
tagline: Your favorite operating systems in one place.
description:
## netboot.xyz

Your favorite operating systems in one place!

![netboot.xyz menu](https://netboot.xyz/images/netboot.xyz.gif)

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

compose:
services:
  netbootxyz:
    image: ghcr.io/netbootxyz/netbootxyz:0.7.6-nbxyz18
    container_name: netbootxyz
    volumes:
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/data/config:/config
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/data/assets:/assets
    ports:
      - ${APP_PORT}:3000
      - 69:69/udp
    restart: unless-stopped
